titleZh: 肌肤长寿：从「抗衰」到「维持最佳生物状态」
titleEn: Skin longevity: from anti-ageing to staying biologically optimal
summaryZh: 抗衰是在对抗结果，长寿是在管理过程。这篇把 ECM 的「量」与「序」拆开讲：为什么胶原纤维排列有序之后，皮肤看起来才是通透的，而不是被填满的。
summaryEn: Anti-ageing fights an outcome; longevity manages a process. This paper separates ECM quantity from ECM order — why skin looks translucent when collagen fibres are aligned, rather than simply filled.
